d: CM Samrat Speech : bihar ke vikas aur sarak kanektiviti ko majbut karne ki disha men ek aham kadam uthaya gaya hai. naee dilli men bihar sarkar aur kendriy sarak parivhan evan rajmarg mantralay ke bich MoU par hastakshar kie gae. is dauran kendriy mantri nitin gadakri aur bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri maujud rahe. samjhaute ka mukhy phokas bihar men sarak netvark ke vistar, behtar kanektiviti aur inphrastrakchar ko majbut karne par hai. aakhir is MoU se bihar ko kya phayda hoga aur rajy men vikas ki kaun-si naee rah khulegi? dekhie yah khas riporta.
